text:
alana: MTD dashboard flag — noticed webinar reg -> attend conversion drop for paid channels starting 3/12. anyone else seeing this?

mike: yep saw it earlier this morning. paid linkedin sessions stable but reg_rate down. could be landing change or utm mismatch.

vikram: ran a quick count: registrations for campaign="q2_launch_paid" — 412 on 2026-03-11, 178 on 2026-03-13. CPL up ~2.3x MTD.

tara: i think one of the creatives lost utm_content yesterday during the creative swap. noticed missing params in the raw hits.

alana: dashboard for reference: https://dash.redwood.ai/r/marketing/mtd?filter=paid (internal)

vikram: SQL I used:
```sql
select date(event_time) as d, count(*) as regs
from analytics.events
where event_type='webinar_registration' and campaign='q2_launch_paid'
group by 1 order by 1 desc limit 30;
```

mike: also worth checking attribution config — last week we changed multi-touch window to 7d which could shift credit away from recent paid clicks.

jon: if the attribution window changed, the dashboard's paid-sourced registration metric would jump around. good call to sanity-check.

tara: i'm patching the ad tags now and will re-deploy creatives with correct utms. sending updated creatives to growth ops in 10m.

alana: action items — 1) tara confirms UTMs fixed and updated creative ids, 2) mike to re-run attribution with 30d lookback for comparison, 3) vikram to refresh the dashboard panels and re-run the query. can we quick huddle at 14:00?

mike: 14:00 works for me.

vikram: works for me too.

analytics-bot: dataset refresh completed 1858001500 (2026-03-21 13:05 UTC)

alana: thanks all — i'll update the weekly KPI tracker after we reconcile numbers. :thumbsup:
